rungs.name: Verification check
rungs.scope: Check one bounded public fact, link, label, accessibility state, or source locator.
rungs.acceptance_style: Exact evidence plus a reproducible check; no novel mathematics required.

rungs.name: Reproduction
rungs.scope: Run or independently repeat one existing build, test, calculation, or public-source extraction.
rungs.acceptance_style: Commands or procedure, environment/versions, result, and discrepancies.

rungs.name: Mapping / synthesis
rungs.scope: Build a faithful map between claims, sources, declarations, proof sections, concepts, or workflows.
rungs.acceptance_style: Complete mapping for the stated slice, stable locators, and explicit unknowns.

rungs.name: Artifact construction
rungs.scope: Create a reviewable code, visualization, documentation, or data artifact that advances a research program.
rungs.acceptance_style: Artifact, tests, reproduction instructions, limitations, and review target.

rungs.name: Substantive analysis
rungs.scope: Perform a mathematically, numerically, empirically, or methodologically substantive analysis.
rungs.acceptance_style: Precise claim, assumptions, derivation/experiment, uncertainty, counterchecks, and independent review.

rungs.name: Frontier research
rungs.scope: Attack a frontier theorem, formalization, stability problem, benchmark, or research-grade extension.
rungs.acceptance_style: Research artifact with field-appropriate verification and independent domain review.
